gen-gf-grandstander-gf-padyakke-expanded: Loud and springy, Grandstander leads while Padyakke Expanded One spreads its serif letters out like knots on a slack rope. Paragraphs would drift past at a stroll, one round bowl after another.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Expressive, Grandstander lands first, its lowercase tall and its ascenders short. Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif of characters floating apart, keeps a moderate lowercase, so the two meet at different heights on the page.
gen-gf-griffy-fs-rowan: Rowan is a friendly serif with generous openings in every curve. Griffy huddles its letters like pressed tiles, and that tight, distinctive display is the draw, so it favors little text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Distinctive from the first glance, Gugi's lowercase rises nearly to the capitals, with curves matching its stems exactly. BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif, slows the pace to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-hepta-slab: Gugi stands tall, its lowercase nearly reaching the capitals and its terminals cut open. And Hepta Slab, a text serif of bent-paperclip lines, stretches each word out beneath it for a steadier, slower rhythm.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-kiwi-maru: Gugi shouts in tall lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, with curves matching the stems exactly. Kiwi Maru does the body work, its terminals stopping far from the stem and its letterspace generous.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Gugi's tall lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, and its cut-open terminals let the counters flow outward. But Padyakke Expanded One, spread like knots on a slack rope, takes more room, so give it a little extra size.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded, a serif, lets each character float apart with a pipe-cleaner feel and counters leading outward. Gugi, meanwhile, owns the headline, distinctive and bold, its lowercase tall.
gen-gf-gveret-levin-archivo: Archivo comes across editorial and approachable, a sans-serif whose curves open outward with a commanding x-height. And Gveret Levin's inviting, hand-drawn feel stands out most, though long paragraphs aren't the pair's job.
gen-gf-gveret-levin-fs-asap: Hand-drawn and inviting, Gveret Levin has curves with the heft of a rope and a pronounced x-height. Asap, a readable sans with open arcs, gives that warmth a sturdy partner made for quick glances.
